payload.evidence_against: T032 registered analog retrieval improved E011 to 8.674114 RMSE but missed the frozen 15% shape-SSE gate at 14.231%. More decisively, a full-grid shuffled-action control reached 8.031442 RMSE, reduced shape SSE by 24.909%, helped 95.860% of wells, and passed every main coverage gate. The available residual action dictionary has coverage, but the registered U/GR/geometry similarity does not identify geological analogs.
payload.evidence_for: DTW/retrieval is materially independent of the closed summary/view/objective families and public source audits expose rare unique candidate coverage.
payload.next_test: Close analog-tail retrieval before selector work. Run T033 action-manifold capacity and T034 legal-identifiability diagnostics as independent gates.
payload.statement: Outer-training-only sequence registration can retrieve analog tail actions that cover E011 shape error independently of summary coefficient models.
payload.title: Registered analog tails provide independent nonlinear coverage
